gaps.reason: rift jump: kicker lip over the moonquake rift

coins.note: mid-air over the rift: on the jump arc of a car that clears the gap

framing.note: chase camera on the start grid facing north: boost-gate pair, monorail viaduct and train overhead, Glass Vault mouth framed by the central arch (20_SPACE4_STAR_CITY.png)

notes.key: none: SPACE has no hidden key (LAUNCH_PROGRESSION 2b, N64 FACT: no fifth battle)
notes.boss: none at launch: SPACE-4 is the endgame race + coin challenge; SPACE-BOSS is U3
notes.rings: car boost gates: ring centre 3 studs above the ribbon (0.3 above the paver top) so the hull (+4.5) passes through the lower opening inside CarConfig.RING_TRIGGER_RADIUS and no bottom rim crosses the gate's centre line; the side rims (3 and 9 o'clock, 10-15 studs either side of the ring centre) do stand on the road surface, and kit/Gameplay ring parts are CanQuery=true while the car's ground probes use RespectCanCollide=false, so a wheel crossing a side rim reads a ~2.3 stud step until the kit makes ring visuals CanQuery=false
notes.coins: station/lateral/height on the race line like pods; coin 6 is on Alt1 (pos is the world point inside the tunnel, 3 studs above its floor)
notes.alt1Aprons: trap audit S4-01/03/04 (docs/audits/traps_space4.md): the fork parapet is open only while its line runs inside the shortcut apron; ShortcutFunnelRail pieces (parapet profile) close both aprons from the parapet ends to the kit tube walls at < 7 degrees, and a wedge fills the entry gore, so nothing faces an arriving car head-on and the inner-bulge shelf/basin is unreachable from either fork
